# Completion-only / masked objective

Both trainers supervise **only action tokens**:

1. Split each hand at the last comma → `(prompt, completion)`.
2. Build `input_ids = [BOS] + prompt_ids + completion_ids + [EOS]`.
3. Set labels to `-100` on BOS + prompt; keep real IDs on completion + EOS.
4. If length exceeds `n_positions`, drop tokens from the **front** so the action
   remains.

::: {.callout-note}
## Boundary alignment

BPE merge behavior can differ when a substring is tokenized alone versus in
context. Prefer locating the prompt/answer boundary from a carefully controlled
split (package path) or a single full-text pass with offset mapping—never assume
that tokenizing the prompt in isolation and concatenating IDs is lossless.
:::

# Raw PyTorch loop

```bash
python scripts/train_gpt2.py
# or: pokerai-gpt2
```

Highlights from `pokerai.training.train_gpt2`:

- Custom `HandsDataset` + collate that pads `input_ids`, `labels`, and attention
  masks
- AdamW at `3e-4`, 3 epochs, batch 32 (defaults)
- Per-epoch validation cross-entropy
- Direct `wandb.init` / `wandb.log` into project `pokerai`
- Saves model + tokenizer under `artifacts/models/gpt2/`

# TRL SFTTrainer

```bash
python scripts/train_trl.py
# or: pokerai-trl
```

Highlights from `pokerai.training.train_trl`:

- Maps each line to `{"prompt", "completion"}` via `split_prompt_completion`
- `SFTConfig(completion_only_loss=True, max_length=n_positions, …)`
- `report_to="wandb"`, `run_name="gpt2-trl"`
- FP16 when CUDA is available
- Saves under `artifacts/models/gpt2_trl/`

# Comparing runs

All trainers log to the same W&B project so bigram, raw GPT-2, and TRL runs are
directly comparable. See [Experiment tracking](tracking.qmd).

# Hardware tips

| Situation | Suggestion |
| --- | --- |
| CUDA available | Default batch 32; FP16 on TRL path |
| CPU-only | Expect slow GPT-2 training; start with bigram + tiny subset |
| OOM | Lower `GPT2_BATCH_SIZE` in config or CLI wrappers |
| Offline cluster | `WANDB_MODE=offline` then `wandb sync` |
